line: Summary: Unranked team event with 16 teams with 3 players each. Ran with a Swiss format and the top 8 teams going into the finals. The event play structure was based on each player having one bey with no repeating parts among the team. Each member played one match first to 4pts and every point earned was added to a cumulative team score (Mad House Style) and the team with the highest cumulative score after the last match won the battle.
